per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Có lần mẹ tôi không có ở nhà, tôi thay mẹ nấu canh cho gia đình. Khi mẹ về nếm thử, mẹ thấy món canh thiếu hương vị của gạo rang giã. Mẹ tôi nói: “Khi cho gạo rang giã vào nồi canh, nó sẽ giúp tăng hương vị, làm món canh ngon hơn.”

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “ខ្ញុំ” for “Tôi,” which is pragmatically appropriate and neutral. The Vietnamese “mẹ” is rendered as “ម៉ែ,” a natural intimate Khmer kinship term for mother and consistent with the family context. There is no inappropriate honorific shift or social-level mismatch.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The Khmer text consists of legitimate Khmer vocabulary. No pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words are detected. Terms such as “ផ្ទះបាយ,” “ចំអិន,” “សម្លចេក,” “ម្សៅអង្ករលីង,” “ឆ្នាំងសម្ល,” “ក្រអូប,” and “ឆ្ងាញ់” are authentic Khmer lexical items.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure and word order are natural Khmer. Noun phrases such as “សម្លចេក,” “ម្សៅអង្ករលីង,” and “ឆ្នាំងសម្ល” are well formed. The sequence of events is grammatically coherent: mother is away, the speaker cooks, mother returns and tastes, then comments on the missing roasted-rice flavor. Minor orthographic variation such as “ចំអិន” instead of the more standard “ចម្អិន” does not impede quality.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves the full meaning of the Vietnamese source very well. It includes the speaker entering the kitchen, cooking banana soup for the family, the mother tasting it after returning, noticing the lack of roasted-rice-powder flavor, and explaining that adding roasted rice powder to the soup enhances its distinctive fragrant and delicious flavor. The rendering of “thính gạo (gạo rang)” as “ម្សៅអង្ករលីង (អង្ករលីង)” is semantically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with accurate semantic transfer, appropriate kinship/pronoun use, natural Khmer syntax, and no fake transliteration or lexical hallucination. Any issues are very minor, such as slight orthographic variation and small stylistic differences from the reference. The translation is professional and fully understandable.

per_sample.text: Tôi còn nhớ đã cùng bạn ăn bữa cơm trưa trong chùa, sau khi các sư ăn xong, vào dịp đi giúp chùa xây dựng Chánh điện.
per_sample.question: Hãy kể lại một bữa trưa đáng nhớ mà bạn từng có – có thể là vào lễ hội, ngày giỗ, hay lúc đói kém.
label: ខ្ញុំនៅចាំបានថា បានញ៉ាំអាហារថ្ងៃត្រង់ជាមួយមិត្តខ្ញុំនៅក្នុងវត្ត បន្ទាប់ពីព្រះសង្ឃបានឆាន់រួច ក្នុងឱកាសដែលទៅជួយ សាងសង់ព្រះវិហារ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំនៅចាំថា បានហូបបាយថ្ងៃត្រង់ជាមួយអ្នកនៅក្នុងវត្ត ក្រោយពេលលោកសង្ឃឆាន់រួច ក្នុងឱកាសទៅជួយវត្តសាងសង់ព្រះវិហារ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi vẫn còn nhớ lần ăn trưa với bạn tôi trong chùa, sau khi chư tăng thọ trai xong, nhân dịp đi phụ xây chánh điện.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The first-person subject "ខ្ញុំ" is appropriate and matches the reference. The main issue is the rendering of Vietnamese "bạn": the human reference interprets it as "មិត្តខ្ញុំ" meaning "my friend," while the hypothesis uses "អ្នក," which reads as "you" or a generic person. This creates a relational/pronominal mismatch against the reference, though Vietnamese "bạn" can be ambiguous. For the monks, the hypothesis uses "លោកសង្ឃ" rather than the more formal/reference-like "ព្រះសង្ឃ." However, it correctly uses the honorific eating verb "ឆាន់," so the religious respect register is mostly preserved.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The hypothesis does not contain pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words. Terms such as "ខ្ញុំ," "ហូបបាយ," "វត្ត," "លោកសង្ឃ," "ឆាន់," "ឱកាស," "សាងសង់," and "ព្រះវិហារ" are legitimate Khmer vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The sentence structure is generally natural Khmer. The sequence "បានហូបបាយថ្ងៃត្រង់ជាមួយអ្នកនៅក្នុងវត្ត" is grammatical, though slightly more colloquial than the reference's "ញ៉ាំអាហារថ្ងៃត្រង់ជាមួយមិត្តខ្ញុំ." The clause "ក្រោយពេលលោកសង្ឃឆាន់រួច" is syntactically correct. The phrase "ក្នុងឱកាសទៅជួយវត្តសាងសង់ព្រះវិហារ" is understandable and fairly natural, though the reference's structure "ក្នុងឱកាសដែលទៅជួយ សាងសង់ព្រះវិហារ" is a little cleaner.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: Most core meaning is preserved: the speaker remembers eating lunch in a temple/pagoda, after the monks had finished eating, during an occasion of helping build the main hall/sanctuary. The main semantic deviation is "ជាមួយអ្នក" instead of "ជាមួយមិត្តខ្ញុំ," changing "with my friend" into "with you." The phrase "ជួយវត្តសាងសង់ព្រះវិហារ" also explicitly says helping the temple build the hall, which is compatible with the source/reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is fluent, legitimate Khmer and conveys the main event accurately. It preserves the religious eating honorific "ឆាន់" and uses appropriate vocabulary for temple and sanctuary. However, the participant relation differs from the human reference because "មិត្តខ្ញុំ" is rendered as "អ្នក," and "លោកសង្ឃ" is slightly less ideal than "ព្រះសង្ឃ." These are noticeable but not destructive errors. Overall, this is a good translation with minor-to-moderate issues rather than a professional-perfect rendering.

per_sample.text: Trong gia đình, mẹ là người chuẩn bị món ăn đem đi biếu, các món ăn cũng không có gì đặc biệt chẳng qua là nấu các món ăn Khmer.
per_sample.question: Ai trong gia đình bạn là người hay chuẩn bị đồ ăn để biếu? Có gì đặc biệt trong cách họ làm không?
label: ក្នុងគ្រួសារ ម្តាយខ្ញុំជាអ្នករៀបចំអាហារដើម្បីជូនជាអំណោយ មុខម្ហូបមិនមានអ្វីពិសេសទេ គ្រាន់តែជាម្ហូបខ្មែរតែប៉ុណ្ណោះ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្នុងគ្រួសារ ម៉ែជាអ្នករៀបចំម្ហូបអាហារយកទៅជូនគេ មុខម្ហូបក៏គ្មានអីពិសេសទេ គ្រាន់តែធ្វើម្ហូបខ្មែរប៉ុណ្ណោះ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trong gia đình, mẹ tôi là người chuẩn bị thức ăn để đem biếu; món ăn không có gì đặc biệt, chỉ là món Khmer thôi.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “ម៉ែ” for “mẹ”, which is a legitimate Khmer kinship term meaning mother/mom, but it is more colloquial than the reference “ម្តាយខ្ញុំ” and it omits the possessive “ខ្ញុំ” implied in the reference. Since the Vietnamese source only says “mẹ” rather than explicitly “mẹ tôi”, this is not a major error, but the reference clearly interprets it as “my mother.” The phrase “ជូនគេ” is understandable for giving to others, though “គេ” is somewhat generic and less culturally refined than the reference’s “ជូនជាអំណោយ” for the act of giving as a gift.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There are no fake Khmer-script phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words. Terms such as “ក្នុងគ្រួសារ”, “ម៉ែ”, “រៀបចំ”, “ម្ហូបអាហារ”, “មុខម្ហូប”, “ពិសេស”, and “ម្ហូបខ្មែរ” are authentic Khmer.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The syntax is natural Khmer overall. “ក្នុងគ្រួសារ ម៉ែជាអ្នករៀបចំម្ហូបអាហារយកទៅជូនគេ” is grammatical and flows well. The structure of “មុខម្ហូបក៏គ្មានអីពិសេសទេ” is colloquial but acceptable. “គ្រាន់តែធ្វើម្ហូបខ្មែរប៉ុណ្ណោះ” is also natural, though slightly less precise than the reference’s formulation because it focuses on making/cooking Khmer food rather than identifying the dishes as only Khmer dishes.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The main meaning is preserved: in the family, the mother prepares food to take and give to others; the dishes are not special, only Khmer food. Minor nuances are weakened: “biếu” has a respectful/gift-giving sense, better reflected by “ជូនជាអំណោយ” in the reference than by “ជូនគេ” in the hypothesis. The possessive relationship in “ម្តាយខ្ញុំ” is also absent. However, the core information remains fully recoverable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a good translation with natural Khmer grammar and no lexical hallucination or fake transliteration. The semantic content is largely preserved, but there are minor pragmatic and stylistic issues: “ម៉ែ” is more colloquial than the reference’s “ម្តាយខ្ញុំ”, the possessive “my” is omitted relative to the reference, and “ជូនគេ” is less precise and less gift-oriented than “ជូនជាអំណោយ.” These issues do not block comprehension or seriously distort the meaning, so the hypothesis fits the rubric level of 4 rather than 5.

per_sample.text: Nếu chiếc nồi đất, bếp củi, hay cối đá biết nói, chúng sẽ kể về những bữa ăn ấm cúng sum vầy, tiếng cười đùa của trẻ nhỏ, và sự cần cù của biết bao thế hệ đã gắn bó với gian bếp này, nơi lưu giữ hương vị truyền thống của gia đình.
per_sample.question: Nếu chiếc nồi đất, bếp củi, hay cối đá biết nói, chúng sẽ kể câu chuyện gì về gia đình và làng của bạn?
label: ប្រសិនបើឆ្នាំងដីឥដ្ឋ ចង្ក្រានឈើ ឬក្បាលកិនថ្មអាចនិយាយបាន ពួកគេនឹងប្រាប់ពីអាហារគ្រួសារដ៏កក់ក្ដៅ សំណើចរបស់ក្មេងៗ និងការឧស្សាហ៍ព្យាយាមរបស់មនុស្សជំនាន់ជាច្រើនដែលបានភ្ជាប់ជាមួយផ្ទះបាយនេះជាកន្លែងរក្សានូវរសជាតិប្រពៃណីរបស់គ្រួសារ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បើឆ្នាំងដី ចង្ក្រានអុស ឬត្បាល់ថ្មចេះនិយាយ វានឹងរ៉ាយរ៉ាប់ពីពេលបាយជុំគ្នាកក់ក្តៅ សំឡេងកូនក្មេងសើចលេង និងការខិតខំឧស្សាហ៍របស់មនុស្សច្រើនជំនាន់ ដែលបាននៅជាប់ជាមួយផ្ទះបាយនេះ ជាកន្លែងរក្សាទុករសជាតិប្រពៃណីរបស់គ្រួសារ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nếu những chiếc nồi đất, bếp củi hay cối xay đá biết nói, chúng sẽ kể về những bữa cơm gia đình ấm áp, tiếng cười trẻ thơ và sự cần cù của bao thế hệ đã gắn bó với gian bếp này, nơi gìn giữ hương vị truyền thống của gia đình.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “វា” to refer back to the list of inanimate objects: “ឆ្នាំងដី ចង្ក្រានអុស ឬត្បាល់ថ្ម”. Since the antecedent is plural, a form such as “ពួកវា” would be more morpho-pragmatically aligned with the Vietnamese “chúng” and the reference “ពួកគេ”. However, Khmer can sometimes tolerate singular/inanimate reference in a generic way, so this is a minor pronoun-number issue rather than a critical pragmatic failure. No inappropriate human honorific or kinship pronoun is introduced.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The hypothesis does not contain fake phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words. Lexical items such as “ឆ្នាំងដី”, “ចង្ក្រានអុស”, “ត្បាល់ថ្ម”, “ចេះនិយាយ”, “ពេលបាយ”, “កូនក្មេង”, “ការខិតខំឧស្សាហ៍”, and “រសជាតិប្រពៃណី” are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. “រ៉ាយរ៉ាប់” appears to be a nonstandard or less conventional spelling of the Khmer verb commonly written “រាយរាប់”, but it is still recognizable and not a Vietnamese transliteration trap.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The hypothesis is syntactically natural overall. The conditional structure “បើ...ចេះនិយាយ វានឹង...” corresponds well to the Vietnamese “Nếu...biết nói, chúng sẽ...”. Noun phrase ordering is Khmer-appropriate, e.g. “ឆ្នាំងដី”, “ចង្ក្រានអុស”, “ត្បាល់ថ្ម”, and “ផ្ទះបាយនេះ”. The phrase “ពេលបាយជុំគ្នាកក់ក្តៅ” is slightly less elegant than the reference’s “អាហារគ្រួសារដ៏កក់ក្ដៅ” but remains understandable and natural. “ដែលបាននៅជាប់ជាមួយផ្ទះបាយនេះ” is a little literal for “gắn bó với gian bếp này” but still conveys attachment/association.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The main meaning is preserved: the clay pot, wood stove, and stone implement could speak; they would tell of warm family meals, children’s laughter, the diligence of many generations, and the kitchen as a place preserving traditional family flavors. Minor semantic differences include “ត្បាល់ថ្ម” for “cối đá”, which can mean stone mortar rather than specifically a grinding stone, though it is plausible; “ពេលបាយ” renders meals/mealtimes rather than explicitly “bữa ăn”; and the singular “វា” slightly weakens the plural reference. No core message is lost.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality Khmer translation with full recoverability of the source meaning and generally natural grammar. It avoids the critical failure of pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliteration. The main issues are minor: singular pronoun use for multiple objects, a slightly nonstandard spelling/word choice in “រ៉ាយរ៉ាប់”, and a few less precise lexical choices compared with the reference. These do not cause major semantic distortion. According to the rubric, this fits score 4: good quality with minor flaws.

per_sample.text: Trái cây đầu tiên Tôi được hái là trái cốc, cây cốc được Cha trồng trong vườn nhà và Cha là người dắt Tôi đi hái trái.
per_sample.question: Bạn còn nhớ loại trái cây đầu tiên mình hái được không? Hôm đó bạn đi cùng ai?
label: ផ្លែឈើដំបូងដែលខ្ញុំបានបេះគឺផ្លែទទឹម ដើមទទឹមនោះត្រូវបានឪពុកខ្ញុំដាំក្នុងចំការផ្ទះខ្ញុំ ហើយគាត់ជាអ្នកនាំខ្ញុំទៅបេះផ្លែឈើនោះមកហូបផង់ដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ផ្លែឈើដំបូងដែលខ្ញុំបានបេះ គឺផ្លែម្កាក់ ដើមម្កាក់នោះប៉ាខ្ញុំដាំក្នុងសួនផ្ទះ ហើយប៉ាជាអ្នកនាំខ្ញុំទៅបេះផ្លែ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trái cây đầu tiên tôi hái là trái lựu. Cây lựu đó do ba tôi trồng trong vườn nhà, và chính ông cũng là người dẫn tôi đi hái trái ấy về ăn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses ខ្ញុំ for 'Tôi', which is appropriate. For 'Cha', it uses ប៉ាខ្ញុំ / ប៉ា, an informal but legitimate kinship term meaning 'my dad/father'. The human reference uses ឪពុកខ្ញុំ and then គាត់, which is slightly more formal and neutral. The hypothesis therefore preserves the family relationship, though with a more colloquial register than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of fake Khmer-script phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as ផ្លែឈើ, ម្កាក់, ដើម, ប៉ា, សួន, ផ្ទះ, នាំ, and បេះ are authentic Khmer lexical items.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The Khmer syntax is generally natural. The clause ផ្លែឈើដំបូងដែលខ្ញុំបានបេះ គឺ... is well-formed. The active construction ដើមម្កាក់នោះប៉ាខ្ញុំដាំក្នុងសួនផ្ទះ is understandable and natural, though it does not mirror the passive structure of the reference. The phrase សួនផ្ទះ is acceptable but slightly less explicit than ចំការផ្ទះខ្ញុំ in the reference. Overall morpho-syntactic alignment is good.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The main semantic structure is preserved: the speaker first picked a certain fruit, the tree was planted by the father, and the father took the speaker to pick it. However, there is a major lexical mismatch against the human reference: the reference has ផ្លែទទឹម / ដើមទទឹម, while the hypothesis has ផ្លែម្កាក់ / ដើមម្កាក់. This changes the identity of the fruit/tree. The hypothesis also omits the reference's final nuance នោះមកហូបផង់ដែរ, meaning that the fruit was brought/eaten as well. These are notable semantic deviations.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is fluent, grammatical, and free of transliteration hallucinations. Pronoun and kinship choices are acceptable, though somewhat more informal than the reference. The main weakness is semantic: the fruit/tree differs from the human reference, and the final eating-related detail is omitted. Because the message remains largely recoverable but contains a notable core lexical mismatch, the translation fits the rubric's 'Fair' category rather than Good or Excellent.

per_sample.text: Khi đi dự lễ cưới, đám tang hay các lễ hội khác, thỉnh thoảng người Khmer cũng mang theo đồ ăn thay vì những món được chủ nhà tiếp đãi. Không phải vì kì thị phân biệt gì mà chẳng qua để giới thiệu món ăn do gia đình mình làm qua đó cũng tạo nên sự gần gũi thân thiện với mọi người.
per_sample.question: Tại sao khi đi đám cưới, đám tang, người ta hay mang theo đồ ăn thay vì những món quà khác?
label: ពេលទៅចូលរួមពិធីមង្គលការ បុណ្យសព ឬពិធីបុណ្យផ្សេងៗ ពេលខ្លះជនជាតិខ្មែរ យកម្ហូបរបស់ខ្លួនមកជាមួយជំនួសមុខម្ហូបដែលទទួលភ្ញៀវ។ មិនមែនដោយសារតែការរើសអើងនោះទេ គ្រាន់តែចង់បង្ហាញមុខម្ហូបដែលធ្វើដោយគ្រួសាររបស់  ហើយនេះក៏ជាហេតុបង្កើតឱ្យមានទំនាក់ទំនងមិត្តភាព និងជិតស្និទ្ធជាមួយអ្នកគ្រប់គ្នា។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពេលទៅចូលរួមពិធីមង្គលការ បុណ្យសព ឬបុណ្យទានផ្សេងៗ ជួនកាលបងប្អូនខ្មែរក៏យកម្ហូបអាហារទៅតាមខ្លួន ជំនួសម្ហូបដែលម្ចាស់ផ្ទះរៀបចំទទួលភ្ញៀវ។ មិនមែនព្រោះប្រកាន់ ឬរើសអើងអ្វីទេ គ្រាន់តែចង់បង្ហាញម្ហូបដែលគ្រួសារខ្លួនធ្វើ ហើយតាមរយៈនោះក៏បង្កើតភាពជិតស្និទ្ធ និងរាក់ទាក់ជាមួយមនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នា។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Khi đi dự đám cưới, đám tang hoặc các lễ cúng khác, đôi khi người Khmer mang theo món ăn của mình để dùng thay cho các món đãi khách. Không phải vì phân biệt đối xử, mà chỉ muốn giới thiệu những món do gia đình mình làm; điều này cũng góp phần tạo nên mối quan hệ thân tình, gần gũi với mọi người.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses no problematic personal pronouns or honorifics. The phrase "បងប្អូនខ្មែរ" is pragmatically acceptable and natural in Khmer, conveying 'Khmer people/fellow Khmer' in a warm communal register. It does not violate social hierarchy or formality. The reflexive possessive "គ្រួសារខ្លួន" correctly conveys 'one's own family' and aligns well with the Vietnamese source.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There are no pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words, no code-copying traps, and no gibberish strings. Words such as "ពិធីមង្គលការ", "បុណ្យសព", "ម្ហូបអាហារ", "ម្ចាស់ផ្ទះ", "រើសអើង", "គ្រួសារ", and "រាក់ទាក់" are all authentic Khmer expressions.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The hypothesis is syntactically natural and well-formed in Khmer. Clause ordering follows Khmer norms, and noun phrase structures such as "ម្ហូបអាហារ", "ម្ហូបដែលម្ចាស់ផ្ទះរៀបចំទទួលភ្ញៀវ", and "ភាពជិតស្និទ្ធ និងរាក់ទាក់" are fluent. The connective structure "ហើយតាមរយៈនោះក៏..." effectively renders the Vietnamese causal/resultative relation.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves all core meaning units: attending weddings, funerals, or other festivals; Khmer people sometimes bringing their own food; doing so instead of eating food prepared by the host; the reason not being discrimination or prejudice; the purpose being to introduce family-made food; and thereby creating closeness and friendliness with everyone. The phrase "បុណ្យទានផ្សេងៗ" is a natural equivalent for other ceremonial/festival events. No meaningful omission or distortion is present.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a professional-quality translation. It is fluent, semantically complete, pragmatically appropriate, and lexically authentic. It avoids false transliteration entirely and handles the cultural explanation naturally. Any slight stylistic variation, such as using "បងប្អូនខ្មែរ" instead of a more formal "ជនជាតិខ្មែរ", remains acceptable and does not reduce meaning or quality.

per_sample.text: Dù hiện nay các món ăn truyền thống của người Khmer chỉ xuất hiệntrong các dịp lễ hội, tết ChôlChnăm Thmây hay các buổi sum họp, nhưng qua quan sát Tôi nhận thấy rằnggiới trẻ rất yêu thích món ăn truyền thống Khmer, bởi vì khi bạn bè gặp nhau thường làm bánh hoặc món truyền thống.
per_sample.question: Bạn nghĩ giới trẻ trong làng bạn có còn biết và yêu thích món ăn truyền thống không? Vì sao?
label: ពិតតែសព្វថ្ងៃនេះ មុខម្ហូបបែបប្រពៃណីខ្មែរ បានឃើញច្រើនក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យទាន ចូលឆ្នាំថ្មី ឬ ជួបជុំគ្នាក៏ដោយ តាមការសង្កេតខ្ញុំសង្កេតឃើញថា យុវវ័យពិតជាចូលចិត្តម្ហូបខ្មែរណាស់ ព្រោះពេលជួបជុំមិត្តភក្តិតែងតែធ្វើនំ ឬម្ហូបប្រពៃណី។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ទោះបីសព្វថ្ងៃនេះ ម្ហូបចំណីប្រពៃណីរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរ មានឃើញតែនៅពេលបុណ្យទាន បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំថ្មី ឬពេលជួបជុំគ្នា ប៉ុន្តែតាមការសង្កេតរបស់ខ្ញុំ ខ្ញុំឃើញថា ពួកយុវវ័យចូលចិត្តម្ហូបចំណីប្រពៃណីខ្មែរខ្លាំងណាស់ ព្រោះពេលមិត្តភក្តិជួបគ្នា គេតែងធ្វើនំ ឬធ្វើម្ហូបប្រពៃណី។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Quả thật, ngày nay các món ăn truyền thống của người Khmer xuất hiện nhiều trong các dịp lễ, Tết Chôl Chnăm Thmây hay những buổi sum họp. Theo quan sát của tôi, giới trẻ rất thích ẩm thực Khmer, vì mỗi khi tụ họp bạn bè, họ thường làm bánh hoặc nấu các món truyền thống.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'ខ្ញុំ' for the Vietnamese 'Tôi', which is appropriate, neutral, and aligned with the reference. There are no problematic honorifics or social-level mismatches. The expression 'ពួកយុវវ័យ' correctly renders 'giới trẻ' and does not introduce inappropriate relational nuance.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All Khmer words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There are no fake phonetic transliterations or Vietnamese code-copying traps. Terms such as 'ម្ហូបចំណី', 'ប្រពៃណី', 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ', 'បុណ្យទាន', 'បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំថ្មី', 'ការសង្កេត', 'យុវវ័យ', and 'មិត្តភក្តិ' are authentic and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure is natural Khmer and closely follows the intended concessive structure: 'ទោះបី... ប៉ុន្តែ...'. Noun phrase ordering is correct, such as 'ម្ហូបចំណីប្រពៃណីរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរ' and 'ម្ហូបចំណីប្រពៃណីខ្មែរ'. The temporal phrases 'នៅពេលបុណ្យទាន', 'ពេលជួបជុំគ្នា', and 'ពេលមិត្តភក្តិជួបគ្នា' are grammatically natural. The repeated verb in 'ធ្វើនំ ឬធ្វើម្ហូបប្រពៃណី' is acceptable and clear.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves the full meaning of the Vietnamese source: traditional Khmer foods are now mainly seen during festivals, Khmer New Year, or gatherings; based on the speaker's observation, young people like Khmer traditional foods very much; and friends often make cakes or traditional dishes when meeting. The rendering of 'tết ChôlChnăm Thmây' as 'បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំថ្មី' is consistent with the reference and culturally intelligible.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a highly accurate and natural Khmer translation. It preserves the source semantics, uses appropriate pronouns, maintains coherent Khmer syntax, and contains no pseudo-Khmer transliterations. Minor stylistic differences from the reference, such as using 'ម្ហូបចំណី' instead of 'មុខម្ហូប' and 'ពួកយុវវ័យ' instead of simply 'យុវវ័យ', do not affect meaning or acceptability. The translation meets professional-quality standards.

per_sample.text: Cách ăn trái cây của người trong làng đã thay đổi so với thời ông bà mình, thay vì trước đây gọt ăn, bây giờ có thể xay nhuyễn, làm sinh tố, làm bánh và thậm chí xay kết hợp nhiều loại trái cây lại với nhau để ăn.
per_sample.question: Bạn có thấy cách ăn trái cây của người trong làng đã thay đổi so với thời ông bà mình không? Nếu có thì thay đổi như thế nào?
label: របៀបដែលអ្នកភូមិហូបផ្លែឈើបានផ្លាស់ប្តូរបើធៀបនឹងសម័យជីដូនខ្ញុំ។ ជំនួសឱ្យការបកសំបក និងបរិភោគផ្លែឈើ ឥឡូវគេអាចកិនម្សៅ ធ្វើទឹកក្រឡុក ធ្វើនំ និងលាយផ្លែឈើផ្សេងៗចូលគ្នាដើម្បីកិនញ៉ាំ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: របៀបហូបផ្លែឈើរបស់អ្នកក្នុងភូមិ បានប្រែប្រួលខុសពីសម័យតាយាយយើងហើយ។ បើពីមុនគេចិតសំបកហូប តែឥឡូវអាចយកទៅកិនឲ្យម៉ត់ ធ្វើសាំងតូ ធ្វើនំ ហើយថែមទាំងកិនលាយផ្លែឈើច្រើនមុខចូលគ្នាដើម្បីហូបផង។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cách người dân trong làng ăn trái cây đã thay đổi so với thời bà ngoại tôi. Thay vì chỉ gọt vỏ rồi ăn trái cây, bây giờ người ta có thể xay thành bột, làm sinh tố, làm bánh và trộn nhiều loại trái cây khác nhau lại để xay ăn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “អ្នកក្នុងភូមិ” for “người trong làng,” which is understandable but slightly less idiomatic than “អ្នកភូមិ.” The phrase “តាយាយយើង” corresponds reasonably to “ông bà mình,” preserving the inclusive/familiar reference to grandparents. No serious honorific or social-register violation is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Failed. Most words are legitimate Khmer, but “សាំងតូ” is a phonetic rendering of Vietnamese “sinh tố” rather than a standard native Khmer lexical item. The human reference correctly uses “ទឹកក្រឡុក.” This is a pseudo-Khmer/code-copying lexical error and is critical under the rubric.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The Khmer sentence structure is generally natural: “របៀបហូបផ្លែឈើរបស់អ្នកក្នុងភូមិ,” “បើពីមុន...តែឥឡូវ...,” and “កិនលាយផ្លែឈើច្រើនមុខចូលគ្នា” are syntactically acceptable. Modifier and clause ordering are mostly Khmer-natural. Minor awkwardness appears in “អ្នកក្នុងភូមិ” compared with the more idiomatic “អ្នកភូមិ,” but the grammar is largely coherent.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The main semantic content is mostly preserved: the change in how villagers eat fruit, comparison with grandparents’ time, peeling and eating before, and now grinding/blending, making cakes, and mixing many kinds of fruit together. However, the rendering of “làm sinh tố” as “ធ្វើសាំងតូ” is lexically illegitimate and would not be reliably understood as proper Khmer by native readers, unlike “ធ្វើទឹកក្រឡុក.”
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Although the hypothesis is otherwise fluent and semantically close, it contains a critical pseudo-Khmer transliteration of Vietnamese vocabulary: “សាំងតូ” for “sinh tố.” According to the rubric, the presence of 1-2 pseudo-Khmer words created by raw phonetic transliteration warrants a Poor rating. No pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words were detected.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure is generally grammatical and natural in Khmer. The sequence 'ម្ហូបអាហារយកទៅជូនជាអំណោយ' is understandable as 'food brought/given as a gift,' though slightly heavier than the reference's concise 'អាហារអំណោយ'. per_sample.text: Đối với người Khmer, bún cà ri có thể được xem là "món quà quê" đúng nghĩa nhất. Với sợi bún gạo tươi chan nước cà ri ăn cùng các loại rau thơm dân dã, thể hiện sự mộc mạc và gắn bó với thiên nhiên của ẩm thực Khmer.
per_sample.question: Theo bạn, món ăn nào là “món quà quê” đúng nghĩa nhất?
label: សម្រាប់ប្រជាជនខ្មែរនំបញ្ចុកទឹកគ្រឿងអាចចាត់ទុកថាជា "ម្ហូបភូមិ" ដែលពិតប្រាកដបំផុត។ ជាមួយនឹងសរសៃនំបញ្ចុកស្រស់ៗដែលស្រោចដោយទឹកការីនិងបន្លែក្រអូបបែបជនបទ បង្ហាញពីភាពសាមញ្ញ និងការភ្ជាប់ទៅនឹងធម្មជាតិរបស់ម្ហូបខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចំពោះជនជាតិខ្មែរ ប៊ុនការីអាចចាត់ទុកថា​ជា «ម្ហូបស្រុកស្រែ» ពិតប្រាកដបំផុត។ សរសៃប៊ុនអង្ករស្រស់ ចាក់ទឹកការីពីលើ ហូបជាមួយជីបន្លែក្រអូបបែបស្រុកស្រែ បង្ហាញពីភាពសាមញ្ញ និងការជាប់ស្និទ្ធនឹងធម្មជាតិរបស់ម្ហូបអាហារខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đối với người Khmer, món nôm-banh-chok nước kroueng có thể được xem là một “món ăn làng quê” đúng nghĩa nhất. Những sợi bún tươi được chan nước cà ri, ăn kèm các loại rau thơm dân dã, thể hiện sự mộc mạc và mối gắn bó với thiên nhiên của ẩm thực Khmer.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no interpersonal pronouns or honorific forms requiring hierarchical adjustment. The hypothesis uses "ចំពោះជនជាតិខ្មែរ" for "Đối với người Khmer," which is pragmatically acceptable and neutral, though the reference's "សម្រាប់ប្រជាជនខ្មែរ" is slightly more natural/formal.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Failed. The hypothesis contains pseudo-Khmer transliterations of Vietnamese food terminology. "ប៊ុនការី" appears to be a direct phonetic rendering of Vietnamese "bún cà ri" rather than a legitimate native Khmer food term. Likewise, "សរសៃប៊ុនអង្ករ" uses "ប៊ុន" as a transliteration of Vietnamese "bún"; this is not the appropriate Khmer lexical item here. The reference correctly uses "នំបញ្ចុក" for rice noodles/vermicelli. These are core lexical items, not minor terminology issues.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The overall Khmer clause structure is mostly grammatical and understandable. Phrases such as "ចាក់ទឹកការីពីលើ," "ហូបជាមួយជីបន្លែក្រអូបបែបស្រុកស្រែ," and "បង្ហាញពីភាពសាមញ្ញ" are syntactically acceptable. However, noun phrase formation around the mistranslated food item is awkward: "សរសៃប៊ុនអង្ករ" is not a natural Khmer noun phrase for fresh rice noodles. The reference's "សរសៃនំបញ្ចុកស្រស់ៗ" is much more idiomatic.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The broad meaning is partially preserved: the text conveys that, for Khmer people, a curry noodle dish is a rustic/local food associated with aromatic vegetables, simplicity, and closeness to nature. However, the central dish name is mistranslated through raw transliteration. "ប៊ុនការី" and "ប៊ុនអង្ករ" distort the culinary referent and reduce natural intelligibility for Khmer readers. Other semantic elements such as "ម្ហូបស្រុកស្រែ," "ទឹកការី," "បន្លែក្រអូប," and "ធម្មជាតិរបស់ម្ហូបអាហារខ្មែរ" are generally aligned with the source.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Despite generally understandable sentence structure and preservation of much of the intended message, the hypothesis commits a serious lexical error by using pseudo-Khmer transliterations for the central food term. Because the mistransliteration affects the main topic of the passage, this is more severe than a minor wording issue. It does not collapse into total gibberish, since the surrounding Khmer is mostly grammatical and meaningful, but the presence of core fake transliterated food vocabulary makes the translation unacceptable under the rubric.

per_sample.text: Nếu là một nhân vật thì bữa sáng luôn là mẹ tần tảo và là năng lượng cho ngày dài.
per_sample.question: Nếu bữa sáng là một nhân vật trong truyện cổ của dân tộc bạn, nó sẽ là ai? Một bà mẹ tảo tần? Một ông già thông thái? Một đứa trẻ vô tư? Vì sao?
label: ប្រសិនបើអ្នកជាតួអង្គមួយ អាហារពេលព្រឹកតែងតែជាម្តាយនៃការខិតខំប្រឹងប្រែង និងថាមពលសម្រាប់មួយថ្ងៃដ៏យូរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បើវាជាតួអង្គម្នាក់ បាយព្រឹកតែងតែជាម៉ែដែលឧស្សាហ៍តស៊ូ ហើយជាកម្លាំងសម្រាប់ថ្ងៃវែង។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dù bạn là ai, bữa sáng luôn là nguồn nuôi dưỡng cho sự nỗ lực và năng lượng trong suốt một ngày dài.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses "វា" in "បើវាជាតួអង្គម្នាក់". Since the Vietnamese source has an omitted/generic subject in "Nếu là một nhân vật", this is acceptable and arguably refers back to "bữa sáng" as the imagined character. The reference uses "អ្នក", but the hypothesis does not create a serious pragmatic mismatch. The kinship term "ម៉ែ" for "mẹ" is legitimate but somewhat more colloquial than the reference's "ម្តាយ"; still, it fits the imagery of a mother.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The hypothesis contains legitimate Khmer vocabulary: "បើ", "វា", "តួអង្គ", "បាយព្រឹក", "តែងតែ", "ម៉ែ", "ឧស្សាហ៍", "តស៊ូ", "កម្លាំង", "ថ្ងៃវែង". There are no pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The sentence structure is natural Khmer. "តួអង្គម្នាក់" is acceptable for a personified character. "បាយព្រឹកតែងតែជា..." follows normal Khmer predicative structure. The phrase "ម៉ែដែលឧស្សាហ៍តស៊ូ" is grammatical, though slightly more explanatory than the compact Vietnamese "mẹ tần tảo". "កម្លាំងសម្រាប់ថ្ងៃវែង" is also syntactically natural.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The core meaning is preserved: if breakfast were a character, it would be a hardworking mother and a source of energy/strength for a long day. Minor semantic shifts exist: "នăng lượng" is rendered as "កម្លាំង" rather than the closer "ថាមពល", and "mẹ tần tảo" is rendered as "ម៉ែដែលឧស្សាហ៍តស៊ូ", which captures diligence and perseverance but is slightly less idiomatic than a polished literary rendering.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with natural Khmer grammar and no fake transliteration. The main message is fully recoverable and largely faithful to the source/reference. Minor issues include the colloquial choice "ម៉ែ" instead of the more neutral/formal "ម្តាយ" and the slightly less exact rendering of "năng lượng" as "កម្លាំង". These are not severe enough to affect overall comprehension.

per_sample.text: Nếu một ngày món ăn đó không còn được làm nữa điều mất đi đó là cách chế biến và hương vị đặc trưng của món ăn đó. Hơn thế nữa là sẽ mất đi một phần linh hồn ẩm thực của người Khmer.
per_sample.question: Nếu một ngày món ăn đó không còn được làm nữa, bạn nghĩ điều gì sẽ mất đi ngoài hương vị?
label: បើថ្ងៃណាមួយមុខម្ហូបនោះលែងធ្វើទៀតហើយ អ្វីដែលនឹងត្រូវបាត់បង់គឺរបៀបធ្វើ និងរសជាតិនៃម្ហូបនោះ។ ជាងនេះទៅទៀត យើងនឹងបាត់បង់ផ្នែកមួយនៃព្រលឹងម្ហូបពិសេសរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរ
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បើមានមួយថ្ងៃ ម្ហូបនោះលែងមានគេធ្វើទៀត អ្វីដែលបាត់បង់ទៅ គឺរបៀបធ្វើ និងរសជាតិពិសេសរបស់ម្ហូបនោះ។ លើសពីនោះទៀត វានឹងបាត់បង់ទៅមួយចំណែកនៃព្រលឹងការហូបចុករបស់អ្នកខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nếu một ngày nào đó món ăn ấy không còn được chế biến nữa, điều mất đi sẽ là cách làm và hương vị của món ăn đó. Hơn thế nữa, chúng ta sẽ đánh mất một phần linh hồn trong ẩm thực đặc sắc của dân tộc Khmer.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses no inappropriate personal pronouns or honorifics. The phrase “អ្នកខ្មែរ” for “người Khmer” is acceptable, though slightly less formal/ethnographic than the reference “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ.” The main pronoun issue is “វានឹងបាត់បង់ទៅ...” where “វា” is somewhat ambiguous; the reference uses an inclusive/general subject “យើងនឹងបាត់បង់,” which more clearly conveys that the community will lose something. This is a pragmatic and semantic weakness but not a severe social-register violation.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The hypothesis contains legitimate Khmer vocabulary: “បើ,” “មាន,” “មួយថ្ងៃ,” “ម្ហូប,” “លែង,” “មានគេធ្វើ,” “របៀបធ្វើ,” “រសជាតិ,” “ពិសេស,” “ព្រលឹង,” “ការហូបចុក,” and “អ្នកខ្មែរ” are all real Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of fake Khmer-script phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The syntax is generally natural and comprehensible. “បើមានមួយថ្ងៃ” is understandable but less idiomatic than “បើថ្ងៃណាមួយ.” “ម្ហូបនោះលែងមានគេធ្វើទៀត” is grammatically acceptable and conveys ‘that dish is no longer made.’ The noun phrase “រសជាតិពិសេសរបស់ម្ហូបនោះ” is natural, though “ពិសេស” slightly shifts the meaning from ‘characteristic/distinctive’ to ‘special.’ “ព្រលឹងការហូបចុក” is grammatically possible but less elegant and less culturally precise than a term meaning culinary culture/cuisine.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The core meaning is preserved: if the dish stops being made, the method of preparation and its distinctive flavor will be lost, and beyond that, part of Khmer culinary identity will be lost. However, “ការហូបចុក” translates more literally as eating/drinking or consumption, which weakens the cultural nuance of Vietnamese “ẩm thực.” The use of “វា” also makes the final clause slightly less clear than the reference, where the loss is explicitly borne by the community.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a good translation overall. It is fluent, uses authentic Khmer vocabulary, and transfers the main semantic content accurately. The weaknesses are mostly in nuance and style: less idiomatic opening phrasing, a slightly ambiguous subject in the final sentence, and a less precise rendering of ‘ẩm thực’ as “ការហូបចុក.” These issues do not make the translation unacceptable, but they prevent it from reaching professional/reference quality.

per_sample.text: Trong làng mình, chưa có ai sáng tạo hay biến tấu món truyền thống, bởi khi biến tấu sẽ sai lệch và mất đi nguyên vị truyền thống.
per_sample.question: Trong làng bạn, có ai từng sáng tạo biến tấu một món truyền thống mà được cả làng khen không?
label: នៅភូមិខ្ញុំ មិនទាន់នរណាម្នកបង្កើត ឬផ្លាស់ប្តូរមុខម្ហូបបែបប្រពៃណីទេ ព្រោះពេលគេផ្លាស់ប្តូរគ្រឿងបង់មុខម្ហូប វានឹងបំភ្លៃ បាត់បង់រសជាតិប្រពៃណីដើម។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: នៅក្នុងភូមិយើង មិនទាន់មានអ្នកណាច្នៃប្រឌិត ឬបំប្លែងម្ហូបប្រពៃណីទេ ព្រោះបើបំប្លែងទៅ វានឹងខុសពីដើម ហើយបាត់រសជាតិដើមប្រពៃណី។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ở làng tôi, chưa có ai sáng tạo hay thay đổi các món ăn truyền thống, vì khi thay đổi nguyên liệu, gia vị của món ăn thì nó sẽ bị biến dạng, mất đi hương vị truyền thống vốn có.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses "ភូមិយើង" for Vietnamese "làng mình". This is pragmatically acceptable because "mình" can indicate an inclusive or familiar 'our' depending on context. The reference uses "ភូមិខ្ញុំ" ('my village'), but the hypothesis's "our village" does not create a serious social or honorific mismatch. No inappropriate kinship terms, honorifics, or pronouns are introduced.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: "ច្នៃប្រឌិត", "បំប្លែង", "ម្ហូបប្រពៃណី", "ខុសពីដើម", and "រសជាតិ" are natural Khmer expressions. There are no pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure and word order are natural Khmer. "មិនទាន់មានអ្នកណា...ទេ" accurately renders 'there has not yet been anyone'. The coordination "ច្នៃប្រឌិត ឬបំប្លែង" is grammatically well-formed. The causal clause introduced by "ព្រោះបើ..." is also natural and coherent.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning: in the village, no one has created or modified traditional food because changing it would make it deviate from the original and lose the original traditional taste. Compared with the reference, it is slightly more concise but does not omit any critical meaning unit.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with accurate semantic transfer, natural Khmer syntax, appropriate pronoun choice, and fully legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Any difference from the reference, such as "ភូមិយើង" instead of "ភូមិខ្ញុំ", is contextually acceptable given the Vietnamese source. The translation meets professional quality standards.

per_sample.text: Khi nghĩ đến bữa ăn tối, hình ảnh đầu tiên hiện ra trong Tôi là gặp gỡ các thành viên trong gia đình, bởi vì thời gian này nó có ý nghĩa rất quan trọng với Tôi.
per_sample.question: Khi nghĩ đến bữa tối, hình ảnh đầu tiên hiện ra trong đầu bạn là gì? Nó có ý nghĩa gì với bạn?
label: ពេលខ្ញុំគិតពីអាហារពេលល្ងាច រូបភាពដំបូងដែលនឹកឃើញគឺការជួបសមាជិកក្នុងគ្រួសារ ព្រោះពេលនេះសំខាន់ណាស់សម្រាប់ខ្ញុំ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពេលគិតដល់បាយល្ងាច រូបភាពមុនគេដែលលេចឡើងក្នុងចិត្តខ្ញុំ គឺការជួបជុំសមាជិកក្នុងគ្រួសារ ពីព្រោះពេលវេលានេះមានអត្ថន័យសំខាន់ណាស់ចំពោះខ្ញុំ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Mỗi khi nghĩ đến bữa tối, hình ảnh đầu tiên hiện lên trong tôi là cảnh các thành viên trong gia đình quây quần bên nhau, vì khoảng thời gian này rất quan trọng đối với tôi.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses ខ្ញុំ for the first-person singular, which is appropriate and matches the neutral/polite register of the Vietnamese Tôi and the human reference. linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure and word order are natural Khmer. The noun phrases រូបភាពមុនគេ and សមាជិកក្នុងគ្រួសារ are well-formed. The verbal phrase លេចឡើងក្នុងចិត្តខ្ញុំ is idiomatic for 'appears in my mind.' The construction ពេលវេលានេះមានអត្ថន័យសំខាន់ណាស់ចំពោះខ្ញុំ is syntactically sound and natural.

linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality Khmer translation with complete semantic transfer, natural grammar, appropriate pronoun use, and no lexical hallucinations or fake transliterations. Minor stylistic differences from the reference, such as បាយល្ងាច instead of អាហារពេលល្ងាច, do not reduce the meaning or naturalness. It meets the criteria for an excellent professional-quality translation.

per_sample.text: Trong cộng đồng người Khmer có rất nhiều cách biếu tặng nhau, thông thường những món ăn quen thuộc, gần gũi có sẵn ở địa phương như trái cây và các món bánh vào dịp lễ, vào năm mới.
per_sample.question: Trong cộng đồng của bạn, người ta thường biếu tặng nhau những món ăn nào?

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trong xã hội người Khmer có rất nhiều cách tặng quà. Thông thường là những món ăn quen thuộc ở địa phương, như trái cây và bánh, vào các dịp lễ, cúng dường làm phước và Tết năm mới.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic personal pronouns or honorifics in the hypothesis. The phrase “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ” for “người Khmer” is pragmatically acceptable and even slightly warm/communal. “ជូនអំណោយគ្នា” correctly expresses reciprocal giving among people. No social-register breach is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary throughout. There is no evidence of fake Khmer-script phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Words such as “សហគមន៍”, “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ”, “ជូនអំណោយ”, “ម្ហូបអាហារ”, “ផ្លែឈើ”, “នំចំណី”, and “បុណ្យទាន” are authentic Khmer lexical items.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The overall Khmer syntax is natural and intelligible. The structure “មានរបៀបជាច្រើនក្នុងការជូនអំណោយគ្នា” is grammatical. However, “ម្ហូបអាហារស្គាល់គ្នា នៅជិតស្និទ្ធ” is awkward: “ស្គាល់គ្នា” normally means people know each other, and “ជិតស្និទ្ធ” is more naturally used for relationships rather than food. A more idiomatic rendering would be closer to the reference, such as “អាហារដែលធ្លាប់ស្គាល់” or “អាហារដែលជិតស្និទ្ធនឹងជីវភាពប្រចាំថ្ងៃ”. Still, the intended meaning remains recoverable.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves the main semantic content: within the Khmer community, there are many ways of giving gifts to one another; these are usually familiar, locally available foods such as fruit and cakes/snacks during festivals and Khmer New Year. The phrase “សហគមន៍បងប្អូនខ្មែរ” corresponds well to “cộng đồng người Khmer”. “ក្នុងស្រុកភូមិ” adequately conveys locality. The only semantic weakness is the awkward rendering of “quen thuộc, gần gũi” as “ស្គាល់គ្នា នៅជិតស្និទ្ធ”, which is not fully idiomatic for food items.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with full preservation of the core meaning and no fake transliteration or serious grammatical failure. The main defect is localized lexical-collocational awkwardness in describing familiar/close foods. Because the sentence remains clear and culturally appropriate, but not fully polished or idiomatic, it fits the rubric category of 4: Good.

per_sample.text: Tôi sống ở khu vực có khá đông đồng bào dân tộc Khmer, trong xóm cũng có nhiều người làm nùm bong khlanh. Với đặc điểm bánh dễ bảo quản, vừa rẻ, vừa ngon lại no lâu nên mọi người rất thích ăn.
per_sample.question: Trẻ em trong làng bạn thường thích ăn vặt món gì nhất? → Tại sao lại là món đó? → Tại sao món đó phổ biến? → Tại sao nó dễ làm hoặc dễ tìm? → Tại sao nó gắn với tuổi thơ? → Tại sao đến nay nó vẫn còn?
label: ខ្ញុំរស់ក្នុងតំបន់ដែលមានប្រជាជនខ្មែរច្រើន ហើយទីនេះក៏មានច្រើនអ្នកធ្វើនំបង់ខ្លាញ់ដែរ។ ដោយសារតែនំងាយស្រួលរក្សាទុក ថោក ឆ្ងាញ់ និងឆ្ងែតបានយូរ ម៉្លោះហើយបានជាគ្រប់គ្នាចូលចិត្តញ៉ាំ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំរស់នៅតំបន់មួយដែលមានបងប្អូនជនជាតិខ្មែរច្រើនគួរសម នៅក្នុងភូមិក៏មានមនុស្សច្រើនធ្វើនំបងខ្លាញ់ដែរ។ ដោយសារនំនេះទុកបានយូរ តម្លៃថោក ឆ្ងាញ់ ហើយញ៉ាំឆ្អែតបានយូរ ដូច្នេះមនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នាចូលចិត្តញ៉ាំណាស់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi sống ở khu vực có đông người Khmer, và ở đây cũng có nhiều người làm bánh bông lan. Vì loại bánh này dễ bảo quản, rẻ, ngon và ăn no lâu nên ai cũng thích ăn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The first-person subject is translated appropriately as “ខ្ញុំ,” matching the neutral Vietnamese “Tôi.” The phrase “បងប្អូនជនជាតិខ្មែរ” is pragmatically acceptable for “đồng bào dân tộc Khmer,” conveying an inclusive/community-oriented sense without inappropriate hierarchy. No honorific or kinship-pronoun misuse is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed overall. The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary and does not rely on fake phonetic transliterations of Vietnamese words. One minor lexical/spelling concern is “នំបងខ្លាញ់,” whereas the reference has “នំបង់ខ្លាញ់.” This appears to be a spelling/term-form discrepancy for the food name rather than a non-existent pseudo-Khmer transliteration. The components are still Khmer-script lexical material and the intended item remains recoverable.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The syntax is natural Khmer: “ខ្ញុំរស់នៅតំបន់មួយដែល...” is well-formed, and the clause “នៅក្នុងភូមិក៏មានមនុស្សច្រើនធ្វើ...” is understandable and mostly natural. The causal construction “ដោយសារ... ដូច្នេះ...” is also appropriate. Noun phrase and modifier ordering are acceptable, and the sentence flows coherently.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The main meaning is preserved: the speaker lives in an area with many Khmer people; many people in the village/neighborhood make the cake; the cake keeps well, is cheap, delicious, filling, and therefore popular. “ទុកបានយូរ” captures preservation but slightly shifts from “easy to preserve” to “can be kept for a long time.” “ភូមិ” for “xóm” is acceptable though slightly broader. Overall semantic transfer is strong.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with natural Khmer grammar, appropriate pronoun usage, and faithful semantic transfer. The only notable issue is the food-name spelling “នំបងខ្លាញ់” versus the reference “នំបង់ខ្លាញ់,” plus a small nuance shift in “easy to preserve.” These are minor and do not obstruct comprehension. The translation is free of serious lexical hallucination or fake transliteration, so it fits the rubric definition of Good rather than Excellent.

per_sample.text: Việc giữ lại và tiếp tục sử dụng những dụng cụ ăn uống truyền thống qua đó bảo tồn bản sắc văn hóa qua quá trình lình sử là những vật phẩm hữu hình mang dấu ấn lịch sử, lối sống và tập quán của người Khmer, giúp thế hệ sau hiểu về cội nguồn và giữ gìn bản sắc dân tộc.
per_sample.question: Bạn nghĩ việc giữ lại và tiếp tục sử dụng những dụng cụ ăn uống truyền thống có ý nghĩa gì với văn hóa cộng đồng bạn?
label: ការរក្សា និងបន្តប្រើប្រាស់ឧបករណ៍បរិភោគតាមបែបប្រពៃណី ដោយរក្សាបាននូវអត្តសញ្ញាណវប្បធម៍ តាមរយៈដំណើរការប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រ គឺជាវត្ថុធាតុជាក់ស្តែង ដែលជាសញ្ញាប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រ របៀបរស់នៅ និងទំនៀមទម្លាប់របស់ប្រជាពលរដ្ឋខ្មែរ ដើម្បីជួយឱ្យកូនចៅជំនាន់ក្រោយយល់ពីប្រភពដើម និងរក្សាអត្តសញ្ញាណជាតិ។

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Việc gìn giữ và tiếp tục sử dụng các dụng cụ ăn uống truyền thống, qua quá trình lịch sử vẫn bảo lưu được bản sắc văn hóa, là những hiện vật cụ thể, là dấu ấn lịch sử về lối sống và phong tục tập quán của người Khmer, giúp thế hệ con cháu mai sau hiểu về cội nguồn và giữ gìn bản sắc dân tộc.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns or honorific forms requiring delicate social calibration in this sentence. The hypothesis uses neutral collective terms such as “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ” and “ជំនាន់ក្រោយ,” which are pragmatically appropriate and align well with the reference’s “ប្រជាពលរដ្ឋខ្មែរ” and “កូនចៅជំនាន់ក្រោយ.” No inappropriate pronoun or kinship-leveling issue is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. The hypothesis contains legitimate Khmer vocabulary throughout. Terms such as “ការរក្សាទុក,” “គ្រឿងប្រដាប់ហូបចុក,” “អភិរក្ស,” “អត្តសញ្ញាណវប្បធម៌,” “វត្ថុរូបី,” “ស្នាមដានប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រ,” “ទំនៀមទម្លាប់,” and “ឫសគល់” are authentic Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The syntax is natural and fluent in Khmer. The hypothesis restructures the long Vietnamese sentence into two Khmer sentences, which improves readability without disrupting the meaning. Noun phrases such as “គ្រឿងប្រដាប់ហូបចុកបែបប្រពៃណី,” “អត្តសញ្ញាណវប្បធម៌,” and “ស្នាមដានប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រ” are well formed. Modifier placement and clause sequencing are idiomatic.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis accurately conveys the core meaning: preserving and continuing to use traditional eating utensils helps conserve cultural identity across historical development; these tangible objects bear traces of history, lifestyle, and customs of the Khmer people; they help later generations understand their roots and maintain national identity. The phrase “គឺជាវិធីមួយក្នុងការអភិរក្ស” slightly explicates the source’s “qua đó bảo tồn,” but this is semantically acceptable and does not distort the message.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality, natural Khmer translation with complete semantic preservation. It avoids fake transliteration, uses legitimate vocabulary, and handles the long abstract sentence fluently. The minor restructuring and slight explicitation improve clarity while remaining faithful to the source and reference. It meets the criteria for professional-level translation.

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំសង្កេតឃើញថា ឧបករណ៍ធ្វើម្ហូបសម័យថ្មី ដូចជា ចង្ក្រានហ្គាស ឆ្នាំងអគ្គិសនី… ភាគច្រើនគេប្រើសម្រាប់ធ្វើម្ហូបរហ័ស ប៉ុន្តែរសជាតិរបស់ម្ហូបនីមួយៗហាក់ដូចជាសាបទៅៗ។ ផ្ទុយទៅវិញ ចង្ក្រានអុស និងឧបករណ៍ដាក់ដាំធ្វើម្ហូបប្រពៃណីពីមុនៗ ពេលម្ហូបឆ្អិនឡើង មានក្លិនឈ្ងុយ និងឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់។ ជាមួយគ្នានេះ តាមរយៈម្ហូបប្រពៃណី ក៏បង្ហាញឲ្យឃើញពីការចងសម្ព័ន្ធ និងការរួមចិត្តគ្នារវាងសមាជិកក្នុងគ្រួសារ ដូចជា ប្រុសៗពុះអុស បង្កាត់ភ្លើង រែកទឹក រីឯស្រីៗវិញខំរកវិធីធ្វើម្ហូបឲ្យឆ្ងាញ់ពិតៗ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi nhận thấy rằng các dụng cụ nấu ăn hiện đại như bếp gas, nồi điện, v.v. thường được sử dụng để nấu nướng nhanh chóng, nhưng hương vị của từng món ăn dường như ngày càng phai nhạt. Ngược lại, bếp củi và các dụng cụ nấu ăn truyền thống xưa, khi dùng để chế biến món ăn, lại làm cho thức ăn thơm ngon, đậm đà hơn. Đồng thời, thông qua những món ăn truyền thống, cũng thể hiện sự gắn kết giữa các thành viên trong gia đình: đàn ông chặt củi, gánh nước, phụ nữ tìm tòi và nấu những món ăn ngon.

per_sample.question: Tại sao có món được xem là “không thể không biếu”? Điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu không có món đó?
label: នំអន្សមក៏ជាម្ហូបប្រពៃណីរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរដែរ។ ពេលចូលឆ្នាំថ្មីមកដល់ សែនដូនតា ត្រូវបានវេចនិងជូនឲ្យអ្នករាល់គ្នា។ បើគ្មាននំអន្សមនោះ អ្នកមិនអាចមានអារម្មណ៍ថាមានបរិយាកាសអ៊ូរអរនៃថ្ងៃបុណ្យខាងលើនោះទេ។

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Bánh tét cũng là món ăn truyền thống của người Khmer. Khi Tết đến, trong lễ cúng ông bà tổ tiên, bánh được gói để dâng cúng và biếu tặng mọi người. Nếu không có bánh tét, người ta khó có thể cảm nhận được không khí rộn ràng của những ngày lễ ấy.

It avoids inappropriate personal pronouns or honorific mismatches. The phrase មនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នា correctly conveys 'everyone' in a neutral and natural way.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as នំអន្សម, បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំថ្មី, បុណ្យសែនដូនតា, វេច, ជូន, បរិយាកាស, and អ៊ូអរ are authentic and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The overall clause structure and word order are natural Khmer. The sequence ពេលដល់បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំថ្មី និងបុណ្យសែនដូនតា is well-formed, and គេតែងវេចនំអន្សមយកទៅជូនមនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នា is syntactically fluent. A minor issue appears in នឹងមិនមានអារម្មណ៍ដល់បរិយាកាស, which is somewhat less idiomatic than constructions like មិនអាចមានអារម្មណ៍ថាមានបរិយាកាស, but the meaning remains clear.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning: num ansom/bánh tét is a traditional Khmer food; it is prepared during Khmer New Year and Sene Đônta; it is wrapped and given to people; and without it, the festive atmosphere would not be felt. The cultural festival names are correctly rendered. There is no major omission or distortion.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality Khmer translation with full semantic preservation and natural handling of cultural terms. It uses authentic Khmer vocabulary and contains no fake transliterations. The only notable weakness is a slightly awkward collocation in expressing 'feel the atmosphere,' but this does not seriously impair comprehension. According to the rubric, this fits a score of 4: good quality with minor non-critical phrasing issues.

per_sample.text: - Chào anh, anh có thể chia sẻ về những phong tục truyền thống của người Khmer trong ngày cưới được không ạ?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “បង” for Vietnamese “anh”, which is pragmatically appropriate for addressing an older male or socially senior interlocutor. The final vocative “បង” in “បានទេបង?” also naturally conveys politeness comparable to Vietnamese “ạ”. No honorific or pronoun mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All Khmer words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or Vietnamese code-copying disguised in Khmer script.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure is natural Khmer: greeting + addressee + ability modal “អាច” + verb phrase “ចែករំលែកអំពី...” + topic + temporal phrase + question marker “បានទេ”. The omission of explicit “តើ” does not harm grammaticality, since Khmer yes/no questions can be formed naturally with “បានទេ”. “ក្នុងថ្ងៃការ” is a natural Khmer expression for ‘on the wedding day/at the wedding’.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis fully preserves the source meaning: greeting, polite address to an older male, request to share information, traditional customs, Khmer people, and wedding day. The phrase “ថ្ងៃការ” is semantically equivalent to “ថ្ងៃរៀបការ” in this context.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a fluent, natural, and semantically faithful Khmer translation. Pronoun choice and politeness are well aligned with the Vietnamese source and the human reference. There are no lexical hallucinations or fake transliterations. Minor surface differences from the reference, such as omitting “តើ” and using “ថ្ងៃការ” instead of “ថ្ងៃរៀបការ”, are acceptable and natural in Khmer. Therefore, it merits an Excellent score.

per_sample.text: - Dạ, đám cưới của người Khmer rất trang trọng và kéo dài nhiều giờ, có nơi tổ chức trong hai đến ba ngày.
label: បាទ! ពិធីមង្គលការរបស់ខ្មែរគឺមានភាពឧឡារិកអធិកអធម ហើយអូសបន្លាយរយៈពេលជាច្រើនម៉ោង កន្លែងខ្លះរៀបចំរយៈពេលពីរ ទៅ បីថ្ងៃ។

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “ចាស” for Vietnamese “Dạ,” which is a polite acknowledgement. This is acceptable, though compared with the reference “បាទ,” it may imply a female speaker or a slightly different pragmatic profile. The phrase “ខ្មែរយើង” adds an inclusive possessive/solidarity nuance meaning “our Khmer people,” whereas the source simply says “người Khmer” and the reference has “ខ្មែរ.” This addition is not harmful but slightly changes the stance.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese or code-copying disguised in Khmer script.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The Khmer syntax is natural and fluent. The structure “ពិធីមង្គលការរបស់ខ្មែរយើង ធ្វើឡើងយ៉ាងអធិកអធម” is grammatically well-formed. The temporal phrase “អូសបន្លាយច្រើនម៉ោង” is understandable and natural, though slightly less formal than the reference “អូសបន្លាយរយៈពេលជាច្រើនម៉ោង.” The final clause “មានកន្លែងខ្លះរៀបចំរយៈពេលពីរទៅបីថ្ងៃ” aligns well with Khmer word order and source meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The main meaning is preserved: Khmer weddings are grand/formal, last many hours, and in some places are organized for two to three days. However, the hypothesis slightly compresses “rất trang trọng” into “ធ្វើឡើងយ៉ាងអធិកអធម,” conveying grandeur but less explicitly the solemn/formal aspect. The addition of “យើង” introduces a minor speaker-alignment nuance not present in the source.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with natural Khmer grammar and no lexical hallucination or fake transliteration. The core meaning is fully recoverable and largely equivalent to the reference. Minor issues include the pragmatic difference between “ចាស” and “បាទ,” the added inclusive nuance “ខ្មែរយើង,” and a slight reduction of the solemn/formal nuance of “trang trọng.” These are minor rather than critical, so the appropriate score is 4 rather than 5.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tờ mờ sáng, gia đình chú rể sẽ mang lễ vật sang nhà cô dâu để bắt đầu nghi thức quan trọng gọi là lễ đón dâu.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns or honorific pronouns requiring social-level calibration. The kinship/social roles are expressed appropriately through Khmer wedding terms: "កូនកំលោះ" for groom and "កូនក្រមុំ" for bride. The phrase "ក្រុមខាងកូនកំលោះ" naturally indicates the groom's side/family group, matching Vietnamese "đoàn nhà trai".
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of pseudo-Khmer phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as "ព្រឹកព្រលឹម", "ក្រុម", "ខាងកូនកំលោះ", "ជំនូន", "ផ្ទះ", "ចាប់ផ្តើម", "ពិធីសំខាន់", and "ពិធីហែកូនក្រមុំ" are authentic Khmer expressions.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The syntax is natural and Khmer-appropriate. The temporal phrase "ព្រឹកព្រលឹម" is correctly placed initially. The clause structure follows a natural sequence: subject group + future marker "នឹង" + verb phrase + destination + purpose clause. The phrase "ដែលហៅថា" correctly introduces the name of the ceremony. Noun phrase ordering is also natural.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves the main meaning of the source very well: early morning, the groom's side brings wedding offerings to the bride's house to begin the main ceremony. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality, natural Khmer translation with accurate semantic transfer, correct relational terminology, fluent syntax, and no lexical hallucination or false transliteration. Minor differences such as “ដៃ” instead of “កដៃ” and the addition of “សុខសប្បាយ” do not meaningfully harm the translation. The output is essentially professional quality.

Terms such as សម្លៀកបំពាក់, កូនក្រមុំ, កូនកំលោះ, សំពត់សារុង, ស្បៃ, មួកការ, គ្រឿងអលង្ការ, កង្ហារដៃ, and ដាវ are authentic Khmer lexical items. No pseudo-Khmer words or code-copying traps are present.

linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves nearly all meaning units from the Vietnamese source: traditional Khmer wedding attire, bride and groom, splendor/beauty, symbolic meaning, bride's long dress, sarong, sbay, wedding hat, gold or golden accessories, groom's standing-collar shirt, kbanh/kben, hand fan, sword, protection, and good luck. per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngoài các yếu tố tâm lý, cộng đồng có những cách nào để hỗ trợ lẫn nhau trong việc chăm sóc sức khỏe và tinh thần, giúp mọi người cảm thấy nhẹ nhõm hơn?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns or socially sensitive kinship/honorific terms in the source. The hypothesis uses 'សហគមន៍' for 'cộng đồng' and 'ជួយគ្នា' for mutual help, which is pragmatically appropriate and neutral. No pronoun-level mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of fake Khmer-script phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as 'កត្តា', 'ផ្លូវជំនឿ', 'សហគមន៍', 'ថែរក្សាសុខភាព', and 'ចិត្តគំនិតស្រួលស្រាល' are authentic and meaningful Khmer expressions.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure is natural Khmer: 'ក្រៅពី...' introduces the exception, followed by the main interrogative clause. The phrase 'សហគមន៍មានវិធីណាខ្លះជួយគ្នាថែរក្សាសុខភាព' is understandable and grammatically acceptable, though adding 'ដើម្បី' before 'ជួយគ្នា' would make the purpose relation slightly more explicit. Overall word order and phrase construction are natural.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source: besides the spiritual/belief factor, whether the community has ways to help one another maintain health and mental comfort. 'ផ្លូវជំនឿ' adequately conveys the spiritual/belief dimension of 'tâm linh'. 'ឲ្យចិត្តគំនិតស្រួលស្រាល' conveys mental ease or comfort well. No major semantic omissions or distortions are present.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with accurate semantic transfer, natural Khmer syntax, appropriate neutrality of reference, and no pseudo-Khmer transliteration. Minor stylistic improvement is possible by making the purpose marker more explicit, but the meaning is fully preserved and the expression is native and fluent.

per_sample.text: Truyền thống tương thân tương ái rất mạnh, khi ai đau ốm hay gặp khó khăn thì hàng xóm liền đến thăm hỏi, nấu cơm, chia sẻ thuốc men.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Truyền thống giúp đỡ lẫn nhau rất mạnh mẽ; khi có ai đó đau ốm hoặc gặp khó khăn, hàng xóm luôn đến thăm hỏi, nấu ăn và chia sẻ thuốc men.

There are no inappropriate personal pronouns or honorific mismatches. The interpersonal tone is natural and matches the communal, general statement in the source.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese or code-copying. Terms such as 'ទំនៀម', 'ជួយយកអាសា', 'ស្រឡាញ់រាប់អានគ្នា', 'ឈឺថ្កាត់', 'សួរសុខទុក្ខ', and 'ថ្នាំសង្កូវ' are authentic Khmer expressions.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The sentence structure is fluent and natural in Khmer. The sequencing of clauses mirrors the source well: tradition is described first, followed by the conditional situation of sickness or hardship, then the neighbors' actions. The phrase 'ចម្អិនបាយម្ហូបឲ្យ' is syntactically natural and even clarifies the beneficiary. Word order and clause linkage are appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves the full meaning of the source: strong tradition of mutual support and affection, helping sick or struggling people, neighbors visiting immediately, cooking food, and sharing medicine. 'ជួយយកអាសា ស្រឡាញ់រាប់អានគ្នា' effectively conveys 'tương thân tương ái'. No major semantic content is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality, natural Khmer translation with accurate semantic transfer, appropriate pronoun and subject handling, authentic Khmer vocabulary, and fluent syntax. Minor lexical variation from the reference does not reduce the meaning. The translation meets professional standards.

per_sample.text: Tôi nghe nói khái niệm tránh mất mặt cũng là một dạng tự chăm sóc tinh thần, điều đó có đúng không?
label: ខ្ញុំលឺថាគំនិតនៃការជៀសវាងការអាម៉ាស់មុខ ក៏ជាទម្រង់នៃការថែទាំខ្លួនឯងខាងផ្លូវចិត្តផងដែរ, តើរឿងនោះត្រឹមត្រូវទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា គំនិតចៀសវាងកុំឲ្យបាក់មុខ ក៏ជាបែបមួយនៃការថែទាំផ្លូវចិត្តខ្លួនឯងដែរ អញ្ចឹងមែនអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi nghe nói rằng việc tránh bị xấu hổ/mất mặt cũng là một hình thức tự chăm sóc sức khỏe tinh thần, điều đó có đúng không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses the first-person pronoun “ខ្ញុំ,” which appropriately corresponds to Vietnamese “Tôi” in a neutral/polite context. There are no problematic kinship terms or honorific mismatches. The phrase “គេនិយាយថា” naturally renders “nghe nói” / “I heard people say,” and the final question “អញ្ចឹងមែនអត់?” is somewhat colloquial but pragmatically acceptable for “điều đó có đúng không?”
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All words are legitimate Khmer vocabulary or established Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of fake Khmer-script phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as “គំនិត,” “ចៀសវាង,” “បាក់មុខ,” “ការថែទាំ,” and “ផ្លូវចិត្ត” are authentic and semantically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The clause structure is natural Khmer: “ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា...” accurately introduces reported information. The phrase “គំនិតចៀសវាងកុំឲ្យបាក់មុខ” is understandable and idiomatic, though slightly less formally nominalized than the reference “គំនិតនៃការជៀសវាង...”. The ordering in “ការថែទាំផ្លូវចិត្តខ្លួនឯង” is acceptable and conveys mental self-care, though the reference’s “ការថែទាំខ្លួនឯងខាងផ្លូវចិត្ត” is a bit more explicit.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The core meaning is fully preserved: the speaker has heard that avoiding loss of face can be a form of mental self-care and asks whether that is true. “បាក់មុខ” is an idiomatic Khmer equivalent of “mất mặt,” and “ការថែទាំផ្លូវចិត្តខ្លួនឯង” successfully conveys psychological or mental self-care. No major semantic content is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality and natural Khmer translation. It preserves the source meaning, uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and handles the culturally important concept of losing face with the idiomatic expression “បាក់មុខ.” The only minor difference is stylistic: the hypothesis is more colloquial than the reference, especially in the final question “អញ្ចឹងមែនអត់?” However, this does not harm meaning or appropriateness in a conversational context. Overall, it meets the criteria for an excellent translation.

per_sample.text: Đúng vậy, người Khmer tránh tranh cãi gay gắt hay nói lời xúc phạm để giữ thể diện, qua đó bảo vệ sự bình an nội tâm.

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ត្រូវហើយ ខ្មែរយើងចៀសវាងការឈ្លោះប្រកែកគ្នាខ្លាំងៗ ឬនិយាយពាក្យប្រមាថ ដើម្បីរក្សាមុខមាត់ ហើយក៏ការពារសេចក្តីសុខស្ងប់ក្នុងចិត្ត។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đúng vậy, người Khmer tránh tranh cãi căng thẳng hoặc nói lời xúc phạm để giữ gìn danh dự, qua đó cũng bảo vệ sự bình an trong tâm hồn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The source uses the neutral collective subject “người Khmer” and the reference renders this as “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ” meaning “Khmer people.” The hypothesis uses “ខ្មែរយើង” meaning “we Khmer/our Khmer people,” which is natural Khmer but introduces an inclusive in-group stance not explicitly present in the source. This is a minor pragmatic shift in subject framing, but it does not seriously distort the meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary or natural Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as “ចៀសវាង,” “ការឈ្លោះប្រកែក,” “ពាក្យប្រមាថ,” “រក្សាមុខមាត់,” and “សេចក្តីសុខស្ងប់ក្នុងចិត្ត” are authentic and semantically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The sentence structure is natural Khmer. The coordination “ឬ” for alternatives and “ហើយក៏” for continuation are grammatically acceptable. “ការឈ្លោះប្រកែកគ្នាខ្លាំងៗ” is a natural rendering of heated argument, though slightly more colloquial than the reference’s “ការឈ្លោះប្រកែកតឹងតែង.” The phrase “សេចក្តីសុខស្ងប់ក្នុងចិត្ត” is syntactically well-formed and idiomatic for inner peace.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The hypothesis preserves all core meaning units: affirmation, Khmer people avoiding heated disputes, avoiding insulting speech, maintaining face, and protecting inner peace. “រក្សាមុខមាត់” is an especially apt idiomatic translation of “giữ thể diện.” The causal/mediating relation expressed by “qua đó” is rendered less explicitly as “ហើយក៏,” but the resulting meaning remains clear.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality Khmer translation with full semantic preservation and natural phrasing. There are no pseudo-Khmer transliterations or major grammatical problems. The main minor issue is the shift from neutral “Khmer people” to inclusive “ខ្មែរយើង,” which slightly changes the pragmatic stance. The rendering is otherwise fluent and accurate, so it fits the rubric category of Good rather than flawless Excellent.

per_sample.text: Chào anh, anh có thể chia sẻ với tôi về mối quan hệ xã hội của người Khmer trong đời sống hằng ngày không ạ?

linguistic_analysis.step_2_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Passed. All words in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Terms such as “ចែករំលែក,” “ទំនាក់ទំនងសង្គម,” “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ,” and “ជីវភាពរស់នៅប្រចាំថ្ងៃ” are authentic Khmer expressions.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_morpho_syntactic_alignment: The sentence structure is natural Khmer. The ordering of the question, verb phrase, prepositional phrase “ជាមួយខ្ញុំ,” and topic phrase “អំពីទំនាក់ទំនងសង្គម...” is grammatical and fluent. linguistic_analysis.step_4_semantic_equivalence: The main meaning is fully recoverable: a polite greeting followed by a request to share information about Khmer people’s social relationships in daily life. The only minor semantic nuance is that “ប្រជាជនខ្មែរ” in the reference means “the Khmer people/population,” while the hypothesis uses “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ,” which is more colloquial and carries a sense of Khmer brothers/sisters or fellow Khmer people. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is fluent, natural, and semantically faithful. Pronouns and kinship address are appropriate, and there are no fake transliterations or lexical hallucinations. The minor difference between “ប្រជាជនខ្មែរ” and “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ” introduces a slightly more familiar/inclusive tone than the reference, but the core meaning remains intact. This fits the rubric for a high-quality translation with only minor nuance differences.

per_sample.text: Dạ được ạ. Trong văn hóa Khmer, tình làng nghĩa xóm, bạn bè và đồng nghiệp luôn được đặt lên hàng đầu, như ruột thịt vậy.

per_sample.text: Dạ, cha mẹ không la mắng nặng lời mà thường khuyên nhủ nhẹ nhàng, dùng câu chuyện hoặc ví dụ từ Phật pháp để con thấm dần.
